basis: Craniosynostosis and digital malformations define disease; intellectual disability 80-99%, corneal/ocular motor abnormalities and cardiovascular malformations 30-79%.
Premature fusion of multiple cranial sutures; no syndromic organ involvement established.
Sphingolipid degradation disorder causing central demyelination and peripheral neuropathy; respiratory failure reflects neurologic dysfunction rather than direct lung disease.
Inherited retinal and macular dystrophy umbrella; no shared extraocular damage established.
Aspergillus-associated hypersensitivity pneumonitis directly inflames pulmonary alveoli and interstitium.
Inherited marrow failure; developmental delay reported in 20/20; congenital limb defects occur in roughly 30-50% of Fanconi anemia. Renal anomaly frequency is uncertain for FANCE.
Basal ganglia degeneration and intellectual disability define disease; strabismus causes persistent ocular alignment dysfunction in 30-79%.
Neoplasm originates in peripheral nerve sheath cells; additional organs depend on the individual tumour site.
Definition specifies POLE-related colorectal cancer; colorectal polyposis also affects the gastrointestinal tract.
Subcutaneous fat-pad abnormalities and developmental disability define syndrome; hearing loss 5/5 and scoliosis 5/6. Strabismus 30-79% omitted because of four-axis cap.
Prostate is a reproductive organ outside the thirteen axes; urinary tract damage is not inherent across this umbrella.
Disease of the common bile duct; extrahepatic bile ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
Vitamin B deficiency is a nutritional metabolic disorder; blood, nerve and skin manifestations vary by the deficient vitamin and disease severity.
Defined by severe recurrent inflammatory colitis and early photosensitive vesicular skin lesions; inflammatory bowel disease supplies the immune mechanism.
Umbrella for infantile interstitial lung disorders; a shared infectious or immune mechanism is not established.
Longstanding hypothyroidism with defining pseudohypertrophic myopathy; cognitive impairment occurs in 80-99%. Constipation and jaundice alone do not establish additional organ injury.
Apple-peel intestinal atresia with deficient mesenteric arterial supply; vascular malformations are reported in 30-79% and are integral to the bowel malformation.
Intraepithelial neoplasia confined to prostate ducts and acini; prostate is outside the thirteen axes.
Axonal sensorimotor neuropathy; sensorineural deafness affects most patients. Pupillary reflex abnormalities alone do not establish damaging ocular disease.
Developmental delay, epilepsy and permanent neonatal diabetes are the defining manifestations.
Inherited intestinal methionine malabsorption; intellectual disability and seizures characterize most reported cases. Aminoaciduria and pigment changes alone do not establish organ damage.
Umbrella for disorders arising from HIV-associated immunodeficiency; organ involvement varies among enteropathy, nephropathy, wasting and cancers.
Schwann-cell tumour of peripheral or cranial nerves; supplied ear and scleral annotations reflect tumour sites and do not reliably establish damage across this broad umbrella.
Frontotemporal degeneration and motor neuron disease; weakness and dysphagia reflect neurologic dysfunction. Hearing impairment 2/8 (25%) is below threshold.
Focal palmoplantar hyperkeratosis with keratotic skin over joints; joint keratoses do not imply disease of the underlying joints.
